result.instructions: Tools for e-conomic, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers have overdue invoices, and how much is owed in total?"; "Draft an invoice for customer 12 with 3 hours of consulting at 950 DKK."; "Show the booked invoices from October 2026 with their amounts.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes e-conomic data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run economic_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run economic_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run economic_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. economic_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: economic_get_self
tools.title: Get agreement
tools.description: The agreement behind the grant token: agreement number and type, company details, the user, the app and the enabled modules. Use it to confirm which company the tools read. GET /self.

tools.name: economic_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers with optional filter, pagesize and skippages. Returns customer numbers, names, contact data and balances. GET /customers.

filter.description: Optional e-conomic filter, e.g. name$eq:Joe or date$gte:2026-01-01$and:name$like:*port. Operators: $eq $ne $gt $gte $lt $lte $like $in $nin $and $or. Not every property is filterable.

skippages.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skippages.

tools.name: economic_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by customer number: contacts, delivery locations, terms, group, VAT zone and totals. GET /customers/{customerNumber}.

tools.name: economic_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Name, customer group, VAT zone and payment terms are needed; read the numbers with the list tools first. Writes master data to the company's books. POST /customers.

customer_number.description: Customer number to use. Omit to let e-conomic assign the next free number.

currency.description: Default payment currency, e.g. DKK. Required by e-conomic.

tools.title: List booked invoices
tools.description: List booked (issued) invoices with optional filter, e.g. date$gte:2026-01-01 or customer filters where the API allows. GET /invoices/booked.

filter.description: Optional e-conomic filter, e.g. name$eq:Joe or date$gte:2026-01-01$and:name$like:*port. Operators: $eq $ne $gt $gte $lt $lte $like $in $nin $and $or. Not every property is filterable.

skippages.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skippages.

tools.name: economic_get_draft_invoice
tools.title: Get draft invoice
tools.description: One draft invoice by number, with its lines. GET /invoices/drafts/{draftInvoiceNumber}.

tools.name: economic_create_draft_invoice
tools.title: Create draft invoice
tools.description: Create a DRAFT invoice for a customer with its lines. It is not booked and not sent: a person books it in e-conomic. The recipient, currency, payment terms and layout come from the customer unless given. Every line needs a product number and a description; e-conomic accepts a price only on a line with a product. GET /customers/{n} then POST /invoices/drafts.

payment_terms_number.description: Overrides the customer's payment terms (see economic_list_payment_terms).

due_date.description: Due date. Needed only when the payment terms are of type duedate.

description.description: Line text, as printed on the invoice.

unit_net_price.description: Price of one unit, before VAT, in the invoice currency.

product_number.description: Product number, required on every priced line (see economic_list_products).

filter.description: Optional e-conomic filter, e.g. name$eq:Joe or date$gte:2026-01-01$and:name$like:*port. Operators: $eq $ne $gt $gte $lt $lte $like $in $nin $and $or. Not every property is filterable.

tools.name: economic_create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: Create a product or service with a unique product number, a name and a sales price. POST /products.

product_number.description: Unique product number, letters and digits.

sales_price.description: Unit net price used on invoice lines.

cost_price.description: Cost price. e-conomic ignores it when the inventory module is on: use recommended_cost_price then.

recommended_cost_price.description: Recommended cost price. Required by e-conomic when the inventory module is on.

product_group_number.description: Product group number, required by e-conomic (see economic_list_product_groups).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with e-conomic
prompts.description: What you can do with e-conomic here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_customers_with_overdue_invoices
prompts.title: Find customers with overdue invoices
prompts.description: List the overdue invoices and the total they owe. Open a customer to read its contacts and payment terms before you call them.

prompts.name: draft_an_invoice_for_a_customer
prompts.title: Draft an invoice for a customer
prompts.description: Find the customer and the product numbers, then create a draft invoice with its lines. A person books and sends the draft in e-conomic.

prompts.name: review_the_booked_invoices_of_a_period
prompts.title: Review the booked invoices of a period
prompts.description: List the booked invoices of a month or a year, then open one to read its lines, VAT and due date.

prompts.name: check_the_balance_of_a_ledger_account
prompts.title: Check the balance of a ledger account
prompts.description: Read the accounting years, then look up an account in the chart of accounts to see its balance.

prompts.name: create_a_customer_with_the_right_terms
prompts.title: Create a customer with the right terms
prompts.description: Read the customer group, VAT zone and payment term numbers. Then create the customer with its name and these settings.

prompts.name: add_a_product_or_service_with_a_sales_price
prompts.title: Add a product or service with a sales price
prompts.description: Read the product group and unit numbers, then create a product with a unique number, a name and a sales price.
